summary.headline: Planetary Apogees and Exaltations
summary.text: Astrological instructions for updating planetary apogees by 52 seconds per year and deriving the heads of the five wandering planets from those positions. It explains how ephemerides record exaltations, falls, apogees, and perigees, and criticizes famous astrologers for confusing observed points with the true apogees of the Sun and superior planets.
